programCatalog.rule: The Claude branch is the construction surface for the complete evolved MCP candidate: existing skeleton plus additive/backward-compatible code, tests, migrations/compatibility, workflows, documentation, task history and evidence. It is not documentation-only and not a parallel production authority.

currentPrecodeState.nextAction: Execute GWC-PRE-B-01 through the direct-GitHub PRECODE bootstrap: observe exact branch HEAD, resolve/create branch-local candidate session from observed IDs only, route intent or ask the canonical three-choice question if ambiguous, reconcile new information, then derive the complete candidate backlog.

precodeContinuationPolicy.hierarchy: PROGRAM -> ARCHITECTURE_PHASE_OR_CANDIDATE_PHASE -> WORK_ITEM -> SESSION -> ACTION -> EVIDENCE -> CHECKPOINT -> HANDOFF -> NEXT_ACTION

historicalRuntimeObservations.rule: Runtime/Task Queue observations remain immutable evidence about the existing system. They may inform candidate design/implementation but never become the branch-local execution engine. Real Task Queue/session/lock/main/S1/deploy activity belongs only to the later integration phase after FINAL_PRECODE_VERSION_ACCEPTED.

readProtocol: Read CLAUDE.md sections 8-9.
Read docs/gwc/README.md.
Read this current.json and resolve currentBundlePath.
Read docs/gwc/PRECODE_EXECUTION_PLAN.txt, PRECODE_ACTION_TASK_FLOW.txt and .mcp/gwc-precode-action-flow.json.
Read .mcp/gwc-precode-status.json for architecture evidence, historical observations and current candidate work.
Read docs/gwc/PRECODE_MULTI_AGENT_COORDINATION.md before any shared-branch write.
Reobserve the exact online Claude-branch head immediately before every write.
Inspect the existing implementation before candidate code; apply REUSE -> WRAP -> GENERALIZE -> EXTEND -> NEW.
Candidate code on claude/ecstatic-edison-v1dyt1 is allowed and expected after GWC_ARCHITECTURE_GATE_PASS.
Candidate work items are not GovernedTaskRecords and do not use runtime Task Queue/locks/sessions.
Before seeking runtime connectivity, inspect versioned audits, canonical-memory evidence, GitHub live and GitHub-published read-only artifacts.
MCP OAuth/bridge is NOT_REQUIRED for candidate build; stale/unavailable live proof becomes UNKNOWN/STALE unless a read-only evidence mirror provides it.
Do not integrate/activate the candidate in main/S1/production before FINAL_PRECODE_VERSION_ACCEPTED.
Resume from currentPrecodeState.nextAction and continue automatically through B->C->D/E->F until the final candidate gate or a true non-deducible blocker.
When a new conversation brings material information, semantically analyze it and project bounded insights before candidate work selection.
Reconcile insights as DUPLICATE/COMPLEMENT/DECISION/FINDING/TASK/CONTRADICTION/MEMORY; accepted non-conflicting changes update canonical memory/backlog, contradictions HOLD_FOR_REVIEW.
For multi-agent continuation, resume the same ACTIVE branch-local claim first; otherwise select the next READY dependency-safe and collision-safe work item.
Persist branch-local claims only after exact-head reobservation; HEAD_MOVED requires redispatch.
PRECODE connection is direct GitHub/versioned-branch coordination; do not open or require MCP runtime sessions for candidate work.
Resolve/create branch-local candidateSessionId only from identifiers actually observed; a derived candidateSessionId is never a real provider conversation ID.
If provider conversation ID is unavailable, preserve null/UNAVAILABLE rather than inventing one.
Route connection intent to NEW_INFORMATION_INTAKE / CONTINUE_PRECODE_WORK / NEW_INFORMATION_THEN_CONTINUE_PRECODE; ask the canonical three-choice question only when intent is not deducible.
Legacy candidate sessions without connectionInstanceRef remain readable and are enriched on resume.

historicalPointerIntegrityFinding.problem: Entre e22214d et 3f635e9, currentBundlePath a designe un bundle absent de l arbre. La memoire canonique etait irresoluble et la CI est restee verte: aucun controle ne validait ce pointeur.
historicalPointerIntegrityFinding.instanceFixedBy: Le commit pair 3f635e9 a repointe vers pr95-phase-b-resolved. La meme reparation avait ete derivee independamment par Claude; celle du pair a atterri en premier.
historicalPointerIntegrityFinding.rootCauseFix: verifyCanonicalMemory() dans scripts/gwc-verify.mjs: resolution du pointeur, correspondance du bundle_id, integrite sha256 et taille de chaque source, approval_eligible=false sur chaque claim, existence de chaque bundle precedent declare.
historicalPointerIntegrityFinding.consequence: Un pointeur pendant fait desormais echouer gwc:verify, donc la CI, au lieu de passer inapercu.

pointerCoherenceRepair.problem: Le bundle courant pr95-precode-gate etait simultanement liste dans previousBundles comme supersede. Un agent qui reprend lisait un checkpoint a la fois actif et perime.
pointerCoherenceRepair.gapInMyOwnCheck: Le premier controle AF-36 verifiait que chaque bundle precedent existe, mais pas que le bundle courant est absent de cette liste. La lacune est de moi et n a ete vue qu en confrontant le controle a une sortie pair reelle.
pointerCoherenceRepair.rootCauseFix: verifyCanonicalMemory() rejette desormais un bundle courant egalement liste comme precedent, par nom et par chemin.
pointerCoherenceRepair.instanceFix: Entree dupliquee retiree de previousBundles. Aucun autre bloc du pair modifie.

sourcePriority.use: architecture, historical runtime facts, previously attested server/runtime state, prior inventories and recovery evidence
sourcePriority.freshnessRule: Always preserve observedAt/source SHA. Historical evidence may prove existence/history but never silently becomes current live truth.

sourcePriority.use: current repository, exact-head, CI, review and any server evidence already published as GitHub artifact

sourcePriority.transport: GitHub-triggered read-only collection independent of MCP OAuth/bridge
sourcePriority.intendedMechanism: A dedicated least-privilege read-only server identity or forced-command collector executes only allowlisted audit commands/scripts and uploads a redacted JSON evidence artifact to GitHub Actions. It must not commit, deploy, restart, claim tasks, acquire locks or mutate S1.
sourcePriority.freshnessRule: TTL per field; stale/absent => UNKNOWN, never inferred.

precodeEvidencePolicy.runtimeAuthorityRule: PRECODE must not require live Task Queue/Governed Session/Lock state for normal progress. If a specific architectural question cannot be answered from versioned audits or a read-only mirror, record UNKNOWN rather than opening a runtime execution session.

multiAgentDispatch.claimCommitRule: Reobserve exact branch head immediately before persisting a claim; if HEAD_MOVED, abort stale write and redispatch.

candidateSession.backwardCompatibility: Legacy candidate sessions without connectionInstanceRef remain readable and are enriched on resume.

intentRouting.canonicalQuestion: Que viens-tu faire sur cette branche : apporter de nouvelles informations, poursuivre le travail PRECODE, ou apporter des informations puis poursuivre automatiquement ?
